name_english: The Yoga of Liberation and Renunciation
summary_short: Krishna summarizes the entire Gita and reveals the path to liberation.
summary_medium: This final chapter explains renunciation, action, knowledge, duty, free will, surrender, and liberation, bringing together all teachings into a clear life path.
summary_detailed: Threefold nature of action, knowledge, and doer.
Role of duty and personal nature (svabhava).
what_you_learn: The ultimate message of the Gita.
usage_note_for_app: Chapter 18 should be used for final guidance flows, major life decisions, and deep reassurance responses.
